d:
Experience the calming beauty of Raga Chandrakauns in this soulful performance by Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia. Known for its deep and meditative mood, this raga unfolds with serenity and emotional depth through the timeless sound of the bansuri. A perfect recording for moments of reflection, relaxation, and quiet listening.
Credits:
Track: Raga Chandrakauns
Performer: Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia
